headline: Claude Helped a Hacker Find a Way to Issue Tickets to Almost Every US Music Festival
context: A researcher found that using Anthropic’s Claude Opus 4.7, he could break into the website of Front Gate—used by every festival from Lollapalooza to Bonnaroo—and freely issue any ticket he chose.
